gradcam.spaceNote: This heatmap lives in the model's own 128×128×12 working space — it is not voxel-aligned with the NIfTI series shown above, so read it as an independent visualization, not a precise overlay on the scan.

biomarkerConsistency.title: Biomarker consistency
biomarkerConsistency.note: Indirect consistency signal between biomarkers derived by U-Net auto-segmentation and the prototypes of the class CNN3D predicted — not an exact attribution of the model, it's a comparison after the fact against a different classifier (nearest-centroid).

llmExplanation.title: AI-suggested explanation
llmExplanation.disclaimer: Decision-support suggestion, written by a language model (Qwen2.5, running locally) from values the system already computed — this is not a diagnosis. Check whether it makes clinical sense before relying on it.
